maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from per-transaction fees and FX on consumer remittances to Latin America, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by individual consumers, often immigrants, sending money home via agents, app and web; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by expanding agent network, digital channels and corridors; acquisitions like La Nacional and Maniflo were occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to Western Union, Remitly or other remittance providers; low switching cost, though licensed and regulated.

notes: Intermex was reported as being acquired by Western Union; answers reflect the business as described on its website.
